modules.dew_point: Magnus at the 5 km point, 2 degC/km dew-point lapse to the cell, capped at the cell temperature
modules.lcl: point elevation + 125 m per degC (T - Td); in-cloud when the cell is at or above it
modules.cross_barrier_wind: KIM 850 hPa wind, fallback 10 m forecast wind
modules.foehn: upstream forecast point in the wind direction at up_dist; dry ascent to LCL, saturated ascent (local moist lapse, 50 m steps) to the upstream ridge up_max, dry descent to the cell; index = foehn T - lapse T; active = condensation + lee depth >= 300 m + wind >= 5 m/s + index >= 1 degC
